yells.engage: You wake the mountain? Then be buried by it!
yells.summon: Rise, stormlings! Tear them loose from my slopes!
yells.enrage: The peak breaks, and the sky falls with it!

lines: THUNDER ANSWERS! The peak has teeth again!
Run, little climbers! The mountain runs faster!
Every stone remembers your name, and none forgive!
I am the storm the summit swallowed!

ignivar_herald_of_the_last_flame.name: Ignivar, Herald of the Last Flame

ysolei.name: Ysolei, Avatar of the Drowned Moon

yells.engage: The cold takes all things in the end.

bigCast.name: Pact Flame
bigCast.yell: The pact is sealed in fire!

yells.engage: The brood wakes! Rise, hatchlings, and strip their bones!
You crunch across MY nursery, little thief. The Maw remembers its own.
The basin has teeth. It will remember your blood!
yells.enrage: THE WILD HEART BEATS THROUGH ME!

nativeZones.name: Eastbrook Vale
nativeZones.welcome: Find Marshal Redbrook in town - he has work for you.
nativeZones.welcomeDone: Marshal Redbrook has no more work for you - the quaint seaside town where your journey began rests easier for it.

nativeZones.name: Mirefen Marsh
nativeZones.welcome: Report to Warden Fenwick at the Fenbridge gate.
nativeZones.welcomeDone: Warden Fenwick has no more orders for you - the settlement deep within the marshy swamplands stands safer for it.

nativeZones.name: Thornpeak Heights
nativeZones.welcome: Captain Thessaly holds the wall at Highwatch - barely.
nativeZones.welcomeDone: Captain Thessaly holds the wall at Highwatch - it's never easy, but with the help of adventurers like you it's now manageable.

nativeZones.name: The Veiled Hollow
nativeZones.welcome: The air hums with old magic. Seek Keeper Saelwyn beneath the great tree of Eldershine.

nativeZones.name: The Drakelands
nativeZones.welcome: Hot wind rolls off the wastes ahead. Dragons wheel over the Drakemaw, and troll fires burn in the dunes.

nativeZones.name: The Frostveil Reach
nativeZones.welcome: Snow swallows every sound. Under the dancing lights, the cold itself feels awake.

nativeZones.name: The Amberfall
nativeZones.welcome: Every leaf here burns gold and red, yet none ever fall. The lanterns of Lanternmere are lit for you.

nativeZones.name: The Willowfen
nativeZones.welcome: The fen hums with dragonflies and bees. Cross the bridge into Bridgemere and rest your feet awhile.

nativeZones.name: The Nightbloom
nativeZones.welcome: Past the Nightgate the air itself dreams. Follow the flower-light to Moonrest, and mind the sleeping world that hangs in the sky.

nativeZones.name: The Wraithwood
nativeZones.welcome: The canopy closes over the road like a lid. Keep to the lanterns of Gibbetmere, and do not answer if the wood calls your name.

nativeZones.name: The Palmreach
nativeZones.welcome: Warm sand, loud birds, and a jungle that eats the horizon. Drifthaven keeps a fire lit on the beach for you.

nativeZones.name: The Evergarden
nativeZones.welcome: Someone is still trimming the hedges, though no gardener has been seen for a hundred years. Mind the maze: it minds you back.

nativeZones.name: The Galecrest
nativeZones.welcome: The wind has never once stopped here, and the Old Beacon has never once gone out. Wickharbor asks only that you close the inn door behind you.

nativeZones.name: The Farshore
nativeZones.welcome: Cross the sandbar and Gullhaven's bell will find you before the town does. The breaks tear open without warning, and the redoubt holds its shore against whatever pours through. They have been waiting a long while for someone like you.

nativeZones.name: The Proving Shore
nativeZones.welcome: The Proving Shore asks nothing of you but time. Learn the camp, strike the effigies, walk the wreck line and, when you are ready, Ferryman Odo will see you across to the vale. You can also ring the bell to go to the vale directly.

hollow_crypt.name: The Hollow Crypt
hollow_crypt.enterText: You descend into the Hollow Crypt...

sunken_bastion.name: The Sunken Bastion
sunken_bastion.enterText: You wade down into the Sunken Bastion...
sunken_bastion.leaveText: You climb out of the drowning dark.

gravewyrm_sanctum.name: Gravewyrm Sanctum
gravewyrm_sanctum.enterText: The air goes cold. Something vast breathes below...
gravewyrm_sanctum.leaveText: You stagger back into the mountain wind.

nythraxis_crypt.name: Abandoned Crypt
nythraxis_crypt.enterText: You cross the threshold of the Abandoned Crypt.
nythraxis_crypt.leaveText: You return to the cold air of Thornpeak.

the_last_keep.name: The Last Keep
the_last_keep.enterText: You step into the cold, silent halls of the Last Keep.
the_last_keep.leaveText: You pull the keep door shut and step back into the Drakelands wind.

dawnhold_castle.name: Dawnhold Castle
dawnhold_castle.enterText: You step into the warm, flower-scented halls of Dawnhold Castle.
dawnhold_castle.leaveText: You slip back out onto the sunlit garden lawn.

nythraxis_boss_arena.name: Nythraxis Raid Arena
nythraxis_boss_arena.enterText: You pass through the sealed royal door.
nythraxis_boss_arena.leaveText: You return to the cold air of Thornpeak.

ignivar_forge_lift.name: The Forge-Lift
ignivar_forge_lift.enterText: The forge-lift shudders and sinks; hammerfall rises to meet you.
ignivar_forge_lift.leaveText: The lift hauls you back into the open air of the keep.

ignivar_forge_approach.name: Halls of the First Tempering
ignivar_forge_approach.enterText: Hammerfall echoes through the Halls of the First Tempering.
ignivar_forge_approach.leaveText: You step away from the first forge and breathe freely again.

ignivar_raid_arena.name: Crucible of the Last Spring
ignivar_raid_arena.enterText: Heat shimmers above the sealed waters of the Crucible.
ignivar_raid_arena.leaveText: You step away from the Crucible and breathe freely again.

ignivar_molten_assembly.name: Molten Assembly
ignivar_molten_assembly.enterText: The opened gate leads into a molten assembly hall.
ignivar_molten_assembly.leaveText: You leave the assembly line and return to the Crucible.

ignivar_inner_crucible.name: The Inner Crucible
ignivar_inner_crucible.enterText: The opened gate leads deeper into the Crucible.
ignivar_inner_crucible.leaveText: You leave the silent depths of the Crucible.

drowned_temple.name: The Drowned Temple
drowned_temple.enterText: You step through the moongate: the air turns to cold water and pale light, and the singing closes over your head.
drowned_temple.leaveText: You surface through the moongate into the mountain night.

wildheart_basin.name: The Wildheart Basin
wildheart_basin.enterText: Warm rain hisses on old stone. The Wildheart Basin opens before you.
wildheart_basin.leaveText: You pass back beneath the stone fangs into the Palmreach sun.

collapsed_reliquary.name: The Collapsed Reliquary
collapsed_reliquary.enterText: You descend into the collapsed reliquary.
collapsed_reliquary.leaveText: You climb back to Brother Halven at the reliquary ruin.

drowned_litany.name: The Drowned Litany
drowned_litany.enterText: You descend into the drowned shrine at the marsh's edge.
drowned_litany.leaveText: You climb back to Brother Halven at the marsh's edge.

nativePortals.enterText: A veil of dusk parts before you, and the Hollow opens ahead.
nativePortals.leaveText: The veil closes behind you, and the mountain air bites again.
